title: Workspace settings screen
prompt: A team needs a workspace settings screen with profile fields, preferences, and save actions. Use the highest-level approved pattern that already describes this screen.

title: Labeled workspace field
prompt: A form needs one accessible text field for a workspace name. Choose the smallest approved building block rather than a full page recipe.

title: Empty collection state
prompt: A records page has no results yet and needs a clear explanation plus a primary create action. Prefer the page-level recipe over the primitive component when both match, because this is a complete state pattern.
